## What I want

One or two sentences. What should be different when this is done?

## Why

What problem does it solve?

## Where

Which screen or part of the app? Name the component or section of `src/App.js` if you know it.

## Out of scope

What this task should not touch.

## Stored data

Does this add or change anything saved in Firestore (a new field, a new kind of document)? If yes, say so. It may need a change to `firestore.rules`, and Claude should stop and ask first.

## Decisions to make

Anything with two reasonable options. Claude should ask, not pick.

## How to check it

What should you see when it works? Say whether it needs checking on a phone.
